author: Eric Ries

decision.reason: The dominant English 2011 trade family presents a stable chapter map across Open Library, Google Books metadata, and secondary chapter summaries. No competing revised English edition surfaced that would materially change chapter order, titles, or scope.
tradeoffs: No full public-domain text exists because the book remains under copyright.
Frozen support therefore relies on authorized bibliographic metadata, chapter map evidence, and narrow secondary chapter summaries.

sourceProvenance: Frozen web bundle only: Open Library chapter map and edition metadata, Google Books bibliographic confirmation, and paraphrase-first secondary chapter summaries. No exact quotes unless separately verified in the frozen bundle.
